checks.verify-integrity: The archive's checksum, signature, SBOM and provenance verify before it is extracted.
checks.version-help: The extracted executable prints --version and --help without system Python or developer tools.
checks.tui-boot-navigate: The TUI boots, navigates the sidebar, exercises an adjacent screen and a failure path, and exits cleanly.
checks.mcp-stdio: The MCP server completes initialize and list-tools over stdio.
checks.update-check-no-self-mutation: An update check reports a newer release without running pip or modifying the installation.
checks.native-terminal: An external SSH terminal opens, or the missing-client message appears, and no process is left behind.
checks.verify-publisher: The installer's publisher, signature and notarization verify before installation.
checks.install-lifecycle: Install, offline first launch, relaunch, upgrade or repair, uninstall and reinstalling the previous release keep user data as documented.
checks.desktop-ux: The app boots, navigates the sidebar and settings, and exercises an adjacent screen and a failure path with no console, page or network errors.
checks.local-security: The local session enforces its token, Origin and single-session rules, and closing either process leaves no child process, listener or port.
checks.update-and-mcp-helper: Update notification and download verification work, and the packaged MCP helper starts.
checks.voice-runtime: Managed voice installs, cancels, repairs and removes cleanly; dictation, streaming, conversation mode and spoken replies work and reuse the downloaded models.
checks.webview2-missing: The app works with WebView2 present and explains how to install it when it is missing.
checks.openssh-missing: Terminal features work with OpenSSH present and explain how to install it when it is missing.
checks.standard-user: Installation and use work for a standard, non-administrator account and for paths with spaces or non-ASCII characters.
checks.terminal-focus: An external terminal opened from the app comes to the front with keyboard focus.
checks.gatekeeper-offline-staple: Gatekeeper accepts the app opened from Finder while offline, using the stapled notarization ticket.
checks.macos-permissions: Microphone and automation permission prompts appear and the app honours the answer.
checks.external-terminal: An external terminal opens from the app for SSH sessions.
checks.native-arm64: Every shipped executable and library is native arm64 and runs without Rosetta.
checks.deb-dependencies: The package pulls in its GTK, WebKit and PortAudio dependencies and removes cleanly.
checks.desktop-entry: The desktop entry appears in the application launcher and starts the app.
checks.frozen-payload-compat: The payload built on the oldest supported Ubuntu release runs unchanged.
